profile.name: Caxton Kiptoo
profile.headline: Statistics and Data Science Student
profile.subtitle: Aspiring Data Analyst & Data Scientist
profile.summary: Statistics and Data Science undergraduate at Strathmore University building end-to-end data analysis, business intelligence, and machine learning projects in Python. Experienced in transforming raw datasets into predictive models and interactive dashboards that support data-driven decisions.
profile.tagline: Turning Data into Insights, Solutions, Decisions

keyProjects.title: Kenyan Misinformation Detector
keyProjects.description: Fine-tuned an AfroXLMR-Base transformer classifier in Python to detect political misinformation across multilingual Kenyan social media posts written in English, Kiswahili, and Sheng.

keyProjects.title: Sales Forecasting & Business Intelligence
keyProjects.description: Built an end-to-end retail analytics pipeline using Python (SARIMA) for time-series sales forecasting and Power BI for interactive dashboarding, analyzing regional trends, product category profitability, and discount strategies to surface actionable business insights.

keyProjects.title: Customer Churn Prediction System
keyProjects.description: Engineered and evaluated multiple classification models (including Logistic Regression) in Scikit-learn to predict high-risk customer churn, deploying the final pipeline as an interactive Streamlit web application.

keyProjects.title: Financial Inclusion Prediction (East Africa)
keyProjects.description: Benchmarked four supervised machine learning algorithms on the Financial Inclusion in Africa dataset to identify key demographic and socioeconomic predictors of bank account access across East Africa.
